meta.title: FAQ
meta.description: Answers about Mewvo: what it does, the warning ladder, appeals, stored data and how to reach staff.

head.title: Questions and answers
head.lead: Short answers. For step-by-step guides, see the [docs](/docs).

whatDoes.a: It moderates a Discord server and runs its community features. Staff warn, mute, kick and ban from one panel; every action becomes a case with a code and the member gets a DM saying why, until when and how to appeal. Around that: a warning ladder, appeals, automod, tickets and modmail, a web dashboard, leveling and other community tools. The [features page](/features) lists everything.

notYet.q: Why can’t I add it to my server yet?
notYet.a: Mewvo is built for and runs on the Mewvo server only for now. Opening it to other servers needs more work first, such as settings and limits per server. When it opens, a button to add it to your server appears on this site, and the paid plans on the pricing page start then too.
notYet.aPublic: You can now: use the Add to Discord button at the top of the page.

free.a: Yes. Everything it does today is free. Paid plans with higher limits are planned for when Mewvo opens to other servers; see [Pricing](/pricing).

ladder.q: How does the warning ladder work?
ladder.a: Warnings 1 and 2 are a DM. Warning 3 is an automatic 7-day ban. After that, the next warning is a 30-day ban, and the next a permanent ban that can be appealed for 6 months. The ladder never resets on its own; an accepted appeal of a ladder ban steps it down by one. [The full guide](/docs/warnings).

howTo.a: Use the link in the DM you got. You appeal to the server that punished you, and its staff decide. Press **Appeal** on the appeal panel and enter why it should be lifted and the case code from the DM. For Mewvo’s own server, banned members use the panel in {support}. You get the decision by DM. [How appeals work](/docs/appeals).
howTo.aPortal: Use the link in the DM you got. You appeal to the server that punished you, and its staff decide. On this website, log in on [My appeals](/me/appeals): it works for every server that uses Mewvo, even after a ban. In Discord, press **Appeal** on the appeal panel and enter why it should be lifted and the case code from the DM; for Mewvo’s own server, banned members use the panel in {support}. [How appeals work](/docs/appeals).

lostCode.a: Press **My record** on the appeal panel: it lists your warnings and any active ban or mute with their codes.
lostCode.aPortal: Press **My record** on the appeal panel: it lists your warnings and any active ban or mute with their codes. The [My record](/me) page on this site shows all your cases.

everyPunishment.a: Most can. Bans and mutes can be appealed while they last, warnings and kicks within 30 days. A permanent ladder ban stops being appealable after 6 months or after a denied appeal, and staff can mark a severe ban as one that can’t be appealed. The DM always says which.

web.q: Can I appeal on the website?
web.a: Yes. Log in with Discord on [My appeals](/me/appeals). You see the cases from every server that uses Mewvo that you can appeal now, and the status of your appeals. It works even when you share no server with Mewvo any more. The staff of the server that punished you decide.

whoDecides.q: Who decides appeals in our server?
whoDecides.a: Your server’s Administrators. Members appeal to the server that punished them, and your admins press **Accept** or **Deny** on the appeal card or on the dashboard. Mewvo carries out the decision; neither Mewvo nor its owner decides your appeals. [How appeals work for your server](/admins#appeals).

otherServers.q: Can other servers see our cases?
otherServers.a: No. Cases, appeals, staff notes and the watchlist belong to your server: other servers’ staff cannot see or search them, and an appeal can only be decided by the server it belongs to. The member can see their own cases, from every server, on My record.

removeBot.q: What happens if we remove the bot?
removeBot.a: It stops working in your server at once. Settings, cases and levels are kept, so everything is back if you add Mewvo again. The data stays until the server owner asks for it to be deleted: in the dashboard while Mewvo is still in the server, or through the [contact page](/contact) after. See the [privacy page](/privacy).

dashboardTeam.q: Who on our team can use the dashboard?
dashboardTeam.a: Members with **Administrator** can do everything. **Manage Server** without Administrator opens the settings pages only, no moderation actions. Members with your **moderator role** (set on the dashboard) see the moderation pages; actions and settings stay with Administrators. Access is checked again with Discord on every page.

readMessages.a: Only to run what you turn on. Where automod is on, each new message is checked against your rules as it arrives. Message text is not stored in Mewvo’s database: when automod acts, its review card in your staff channel on Discord shows a short excerpt, and staff can attach an excerpt to a case as evidence. If you turn on message logs, edited and deleted messages are posted to your log channel on Discord.

stored.a: Discord IDs, your levels and XP, moderation cases, appeals and what you write in forms or tickets, and a few things you choose to save, such as a birthday. The bot never asks for an email or a password. If you create a Mewvo account on this website, it stores a username and a one-way scrypt hash of your password (never the password itself), still no email. Nothing is ever sold. The [privacy page](/privacy) has the full list, and `/wipedata` deletes your levels and birthday in that server, plus your to-do list, reminders and stored Discord login. Moderation records stay; see the privacy page for why.

reachStaff.q: How do I reach the staff?
reachStaff.a: Ask the staff of your own server first: DM the bot and choose **Send to staff** (modmail; Mewvo asks which server it is for), or open a ticket from that server’s ticket panel. To report a staff member, use **Report staff** on the appeal panel; only that server’s administrators see those reports. Questions about Mewvo itself, or about Mewvo’s own server, go to {support}.

down.a: Check the [status page](/status). It shows whether the bot is online; press Refresh there for the latest state.
